recipes.name: Pitta bread pizzas
recipes.method_note: Children can make their own. Lay the toppings out in bowls.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Lay {{ing:pitta-bread}} on a tray.
Mix {{ing:passata}} with {{ing:dried-oregano}}. Spread over the pittas.
Tear over {{ing:mozzarella}}. Add halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}}.
Bake 10 minutes, until the cheese bubbles.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-basil}}. Cut into quarters.
Heat the oven to 200C. Unroll {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Scatter half with grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} and {{ing:paprika}}. Fold the other half over. Press down.
Cut into 1 cm strips. Twist each one.
Lay on a lined tray. Bake 12 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Heat the oven to 200C. Twist each of {{ing:chipolatas}} in the middle to make two.
Snip apart. Roast on a tray 20 minutes.
Mix {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}. Toss with the hot sausages.
Roast 5 minutes more, until sticky.
Scatter with {{ing:sesame-seeds}}. Serve on sticks.

recipes.name: Chicken satay skewers
recipes.method_note: Peanuts: tell guests, and keep these well apart if anyone has an allergy.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} into strips. Toss with {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:curry-powder}}.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill on a high heat 8 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Warm {{ing:peanut-butter}} with half of {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} until smooth.
Stir in the juice of {{ing:lime}} and {{ing:sweet-chilli-sauce}}. Serve for dipping.
Blend {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}, {{ing:spring-onion}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:egg-white}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}} to a paste.
Spread thickly over {{ing:bread-slice-medium}}.
Press the paste side into {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Shallow-fry in {{ing:vegetable-oil}}, paste side down, 2 minutes. Turn. Fry 1 minute more.
Drain on kitchen paper. Cut into triangles.
Mix {{ing:cream-cheese}} with chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Spread over {{ing:tortilla-wrap}}.
Lay {{ing:smoked-salmon}} on top. Add thin strips of {{ing:cucumber}}.
Roll up tightly. Wrap in cling film. Chill 1 hour.
Slice into rounds.

recipes.name: Loaded nachos with guacamole and salsa

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Spread {{ing:tortilla-chips}} on a tray.
Drain {{ing:black-beans-tinned}}. Toss with {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Scatter over.
Bake 8 minutes, until warm.
Spoon over {{ing:salsa-dip}} and {{ing:guacamole}}.
Scatter sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.

recipes.name: Hummus and crudité cups
recipes.method_note: One cup each means no double dipping.

steps.instruction: Spoon {{ing:hummus}} into the bottom of 6 small cups.
Cut {{ing:carrot-medium}}, {{ing:cucumber}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} into long sticks.
Stand the sticks and {{ing:breadsticks}} in the hummus.

recipes.name: Homemade beef burgers
recipes.method_note: The dip stops them doming as they cook.

steps.instruction: Grate {{ing:onion-medium}}. Mix into {{ing:beef-mince-20-fat}} with {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Shape into 4 burgers, a little wider than {{ing:burger-bun}}. Press a dip in the middle.
Put a griddle pan on a high heat.
Cook the burgers 4 minutes each side.
Add a slice of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} for the last minute.
Serve in toasted buns with {{ing:lettuce-iceberg}} and sliced {{ing:tomato-medium}}.
Slice {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}}, {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:red-onion}} into strips.
Toss with {{ing:smoked-paprika}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Put a large frying pan on a high heat.
Fry 10 minutes, stirring, until the chicken is cooked and the peppers charred.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}.
Serve in warm {{ing:tortilla-wrap}} with {{ing:soured-cream}}.
Mix {{ing:beef-mince-5-fat}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and half of {{ing:parmesan}}. Roll 20 balls.
Brown in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes, turning. Lift out.
Fry sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} 1 minute. Add {{ing:passata}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Return the meatballs. Simmer 15 minutes, until cooked through.
Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Serve with the sauce, torn {{ing:fresh-basil}} and the rest of the parmesan.
Heat the oven to 220C. Cut {{ing:cod-fillet}} into thick fingers.
Roll in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Dip in beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Press into {{ing:panko}}.
Lay on an oiled tray. Drizzle with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Bake 15 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Stir the zest of {{ing:lemon}} into {{ing:mayonnaise}} for dipping.
Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:mirin}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Fry {{ing:salmon-fillet}} skin side down 4 minutes. Turn.
Pour in the sauce. Bubble 3 minutes, spooning it over, until sticky.
Steam {{ing:broccoli-head}} florets 4 minutes.
Serve with the rice. Sprinkle {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

recipes.name: King prawn and pea paella
recipes.method_note: No stirring after the stock goes in. The crust on the bottom is the best bit.

steps.instruction: Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a wide pan 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:saffron}}. Fry 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}. Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Do not stir again.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Push {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:peas-frozen}} into the rice. Cook 5 minutes, until the prawns are pink.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with {{ing:lemon}} wedges.

recipes.name: Quick margherita pizza
recipes.method_note: No yeast and no waiting: the yoghurt makes it rise.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 240C.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} to a soft dough. Knead 1 minute.
Split in two. Roll each thinly. Lay on oiled trays.
Spread with {{ing:passata}} mixed with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Tear over {{ing:mozzarella}}. Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Bake 12 minutes, until crisp. Scatter {{ing:fresh-basil}}.
Cut {{ing:halloumi}} into fingers. Slice {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:red-onion}}.
Toss the vegetables with {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry in a hot pan 8 minutes, until charred. Push to one side.
Fry the halloumi 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}.
Serve in warm {{ing:tortilla-wrap}} with {{ing:guacamole}}.
Drain {{ing:kidney-beans-tinned}} and {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}}. Mash the beans roughly with {{ing:cumin-ground}}.
Spread over 4 of {{ing:tortilla-wrap}}. Scatter sweetcorn and grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Top with the other wraps.
Cook in a dry frying pan 3 minutes each side, until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges. Serve with {{ing:salsa-dip}}.

recipes.name: Spiced black bean burgers
recipes.method_note: Chilling firms them so they hold together in the pan.

steps.instruction: Drain {{ing:black-beans-tinned}}. Mash in a bowl, leaving some whole.
Grate in {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Add {{ing:cumin-ground}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}.
Shape into 4 burgers. Chill 20 minutes.
Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} 4 minutes each side, until crisp.
Serve in {{ing:bread-roll-white}} with sliced {{ing:avocado}} and {{ing:tomato-medium}}.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and black bean tacos

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Dice {{ing:sweet-potato}}. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Roast 25 minutes, until soft and charred.
Warm drained {{ing:black-beans-tinned}} in a pan.
Shred {{ing:red-cabbage}}. Toss with the juice of one {{ing:lime}}.
Fill warm {{ing:tortilla-wrap}} with potato, beans and cabbage.
Top with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Serve with lime wedges.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} finely.
Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} 10 minutes, until soft.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add {{ing:lentils-red-dry}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:dried-oregano}}.
Simmer 25 minutes, until thick.
Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} for the time on the packet. Serve with the sauce.
Heat the oven to 220C.
Cut {{ing:potato-large}} into wedges, skin on.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Roast 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Shred {{ing:red-cabbage}}. Grate {{ing:carrot-medium}}.
Slice {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:spring-onion}} thinly.
Toss with the juice of {{ing:lime}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Mash soft {{ing:butter-unsalted}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Spread over {{ing:sourdough}}.
Wrap in foil. Bake 10 minutes. Open the foil. Bake 5 minutes more.
Tear {{ing:cos-lettuce}} into a bowl. Slice in {{ing:cucumber}}.
Whisk {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Toss as you serve.
Drain {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}}.
Quarter {{ing:cherry-tomato}}. Chop {{ing:red-onion}} finely.
Mix with the juice of {{ing:lime}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line two 20 cm tins.
Beat 225 g of {{ing:butter-unsalted}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} until pale.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}. Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, 50 g of {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Divide between the tins. Bake 25 minutes, until springy. Cool.
Beat the rest of the butter with {{ing:icing-sugar}}, the rest of the cocoa and melted {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.
Sandwich and cover the cakes. Add candles.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line two 20 cm tins.
Beat 225 g of {{ing:butter-unsalted}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, half of {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and half of {{ing:sprinkles}}.
Divide between the tins. Bake 25 minutes. Cool.
Beat the rest of the butter, {{ing:icing-sugar}}, {{ing:milk-whole}} and the rest of the vanilla until fluffy.
Sandwich and cover. Shower with the rest of the sprinkles.

recipes.name: Fudgy chocolate brownies
recipes.method_note: They firm up as they cool. Underbaked is right.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}} and {{ing:butter-unsalted}} together. Cool a little.
Whisk {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:egg-medium}} until thick and pale.
Fold in the chocolate, then {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until set at the edges with a slight wobble.
Cool in the tin before cutting into 16.
Heat the oven to 180C. Put 12 cases in a bun tin.
Beat 125 g of {{ing:butter-unsalted}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Divide between the cases. Bake 18 minutes. Cool.
Beat the rest of the butter with {{ing:icing-sugar}} until fluffy.
Pipe or spread on top. Add {{ing:sprinkles}}.

recipes.name: Rocky road
recipes.method_note: Most marshmallows have gelatine in them, so this is not vegetarian.

steps.instruction: Line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt {{ing:milk-chocolate-bar}}, {{ing:dark-chocolate}}, {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:golden-syrup}} together.
Break {{ing:digestive-biscuit}} into pieces. Halve {{ing:marshmallows}} and {{ing:glace-cherries}}.
Stir everything into the chocolate.
Press into the tin. Chill 2 hours, until firm. Cut into squares.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}} into warm {{ing:double-cream}} for a sauce.
Slice {{ing:strawberries}}.
Put scoops of {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}} in glasses.
Let everyone add strawberries, sauce and {{ing:sprinkles}}.

recipes.name: Vegan chocolate birthday cake
recipes.method_note: The vinegar and bicarbonate make it rise without eggs.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line two 20 cm tins.
Mix {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, 50 g of {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}.
Whisk {{ing:oat-milk}}, {{ing:vegetable-oil}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}. Stir into the flour.
Divide between the tins. Bake 30 minutes. Cool.
Beat {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} with {{ing:icing-sugar}} and the rest of the cocoa.
Sandwich and cover the cakes.

recipes.name: Rainbow fruit skewers with chocolate dip

steps.instruction: Hull {{ing:strawberries}}. Peel and chunk half of {{ing:pineapple}} and {{ing:kiwi}}.
Thread onto skewers in rainbow order with {{ing:grapes}} and {{ing:blueberries}}.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} over a pan of barely simmering water.
Serve the skewers with the chocolate for dipping.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line two trays.
Beat {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}. Add {{ing:oat-milk}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}.
Chop {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir in.
Roll 16 balls. Space well apart on the trays.
Bake 11 minutes, until golden at the edges. Cool on the trays.
Crush {{ing:raspberries}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Sieve into a jug.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}} and ice.
Hull {{ing:strawberries}}.
Blend with {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}} until frothy.
Pour into glasses with straws.
Put 3 {{ing:raspberries}} in each glass.
Add a little {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Top up with chilled {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it to be

recipes.name: Birthday rum punch
recipes.method_note: The spirit is rum. Make a jug without it for the drivers.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:spirit-40}} and {{ing:orange-juice}} into a big jug.
Add the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Chunk half of {{ing:pineapple}}. Add.
Top up with {{ing:ginger-ale}} and lots of ice.
